version: Glide execution scheduler v01; scheduling excluded from scientific identity

rationale.campaign_concurrency: Two concurrent campaigns are rejected: with a shared Job Control host name the second campaign dies in [transfer] [local_copy]; with unique host names the second campaign still stalled >20 min with no subjob output (experiment_dual8). Concurrency 1 is the only configuration with clean end-to-end evidence.
rationale.njobs_per_campaign: Measured on rerun ranks 1-10 against grid 7TRS: NJOBS 4 = 199.57 s, NJOBS 8 = 198.93 s, NJOBS 16 = 260.33 s. NJOBS 16 is 31% slower, so 8 is selected. All three reproduced reference scores exactly (delta 0.0).
rationale.resource_budget: 8 active subjobs on 32 logical CPUs (~25% utilisation observed), leaving system headroom as required.

host_identity: unique per campaign work directory (see host_identity in pacer_xr_glide_scheduler_v01.py)
